chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya al-Halabi, from 'Abd al-Hamid al-Ta'i, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: Indeed, knowledge is inherited, so no knowledgeable one dies except that he leaves behind one who knows the like of his knowledge, or whatever Allah wills.

key_terms.يُتَوَارَثُ: is inherited and passed on from one to another

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain that sacred knowledge continues after the death of a scholar or Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that divinely guided knowledge does not perish with the death of a scholar, but is passed on in succession. In its chapter context in al-Kafi, it highlights the inherited transmission of knowledge among the Imams عليهم السلام and affirms continuity in religious authority.
